name: What is involved in a typical vanity and cabinet installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a typical vanity and cabinet installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical vanity and cabinet installation project begins with careful measurement and planning to ensure proper fit and functionality. We then prepare the space, which may include removing old fixtures or minor wall modifications. The installation process involves assembling and securing the new cabinets and vanity, ensuring they are level and properly aligned. Finally, we install countertops, sinks, faucets, and any associated plumbing connections. We also ensure all doors and drawers operate smoothly and make any necessary adjustments for a finished look.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes planning, site preparation, cabinet and vanity installation, countertop and fixture setup, and final adjustments.
